title: Wire DutyCycleTracker to Medium simulator
description:
DutyCycleTracker exists but may not be enforced in Medium TX path. Verify and wire up:

1. Check if Medium.start_tx() consults DutyCycleTracker before allowing TX
2. If not, add per-node DutyCycleTracker instances
3. Return TX_FAIL when duty cycle exceeded (EU868 1% limit)
4. Track per-subband for EU868 (g, g1, g2 have different limits)
5. Add metrics for duty cycle violations

This is critical for realistic EU868 simulation - nodes that ignore duty cycle will see TX_FAIL in reality.
